checkpoints.reasoning: Introductions only. Financial interests, donor family ties, and artistic objections suggest possible motives but no crime evidence distinguishes anyone.

Donor threatens director job, education, artists credit and ownership integrity. Security privacy provides concealment; poison exhibit and private engraved glass suggest means, but access is not established.
Death follows private toast, raising catering and service access. Unsigned donor gift retains preventive motives but no direct proof of any suspect.

Nearly everyone has a grievance or exposure risk. Hugh admits altering a file and faces public professional ruin; financial desperation increases Elle and Al, while Tess has inheritance leverage. No opportunity chain yet.

Cyanide isolated to individual glass implies poisoning unattended place or subsequent service. Empty exhibit bottle with hidden split favors someone familiar with handling or preparation access. Staff access matters, but catering alone is not proved.

Al explicitly combines bottle preview with sitting beside unattended glass; Tess arranged toast and visited place; Brie brought flavoring. Hugh and Art know original contents and hid or minimized it; Chip can manipulate closure. Several viable chains remain.

Band scrap supports direct transfer from bottle into glass but is not a unique match. Clean ingredient container weakens ingredient-source poisoning, not Brie adding poison separately. Dr Art has explicit knowledge and cupboard access; Al and Tess retain glass opportunity. Many motives partly settled.

Al invents red-faced silver-backed sculpture leaf, directly contradicted by retained bronze powder and gold transfer leaf sample. He attended bottle preview and sat beside unattended glass. The false explanation addresses the transfer clue; reduced settlement supplies motive.

final_feedback.fairness: Fair inferential solution: Al has access to both ends, payment pressure, and a checkable material lie linking him to bottle-paper transfer. Scrap is explicitly not uniquely matched, so evidence is strong inference rather than physical certainty.

remaining_plausible_alternatives.name: Brie DeVivre
remaining_plausible_alternatives.why: Actually put flavoring into glass, then left it unattended. A clean retained ingredient cannot exclude adding cyanide separately; financial pressure remains.

remaining_plausible_alternatives.name: Chip Patina
remaining_plausible_alternatives.why: Fitted the closure, owns matching paper, and falsified insurance date. Could manipulate bottle and use staff keys, although private-glass access is not established.

remaining_plausible_alternatives.name: Barb Dwyer
remaining_plausible_alternatives.why: Deliberately prevented recording, falsified fault entry, and checked unattended place. Concealment and opportunity remain suspicious, but poison-specific knowledge is weaker.

final_feedback.contrivance: Al volunteering such a specific false red/silver explanation despite a documented gold sample feels engineered to reveal him. Many corrective settlements and retained originals arrive together; convenient, though they make red herrings legible.
final_feedback.voice: Occupational voices and relationships are distinct, especially Brie, Chip, Monet, Reed and Sue. Repeated confessional pivots and direct address in final answers create a shared rhythm.
final_feedback.final_speeches_interpret_puzzle: Yes. They explicitly resolve camera power, sealed water, studio collapse, sculpture materials, loan/model distinctions and the tour route. Players still compare Al against the sample, but much alternative elimination is spoken aloud.

post_vote_feedback: Confession confirms Al using the precise preview-to-glass chain and false-material clue available before voting. No new decisive evidence is required. Emotional domestic pressure lands, although explaining guilt through publicity fraud is weaker than his earlier withheld-payment desperation. Other endings give satisfying concrete consequences and relationships, but repeated denial/evidence-summary/accountability structure can feel uniform over 22 speeches.
